blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: . Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have made them widely used for code-related tasks. Identifier names are statistically informative in naturally occurring code, but their information is not always reliable. We investigate whether current LLMs assign disproportionate weight to lexical cues when renaming preserves program structure. We introduce Face/Off, a semantics-preserving identifier-renaming framework, and evaluate progressive naming conditions across multiple models and code-comprehension tasks. Within this framework, lexical overemphasis is pervasive across the evaluated models and primary tasks: performance generally decreases as identifier information is removed or made misleading, and outputs are often directed toward the meanings suggested by misleading names. The pattern persists under representative prompt- and fine-tuning-based interventions, suggesting that lexical overemphasis is an entrenched problem. A type-inference control confirms a boundary: naming effects are smaller when the answer is locally recoverable without the target name. These results do not imply that identifiers are unhelpful; rather, they reveal a systematic vulnerability in how current LLMs balance lexical cues against program structure. Our findings motivate evaluations and modeling methods that preserve the benefits of natural code regularities while keeping conclusions grounded in accurate, formalized code semantics.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) are now widely used for source-code tasks ( Feng et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2021 ; Xu et al., 2022 ) , including code search ( Li et al., 2024a ) , code summarization ( Ahmed et al., 2024 ) , clone detection ( Khajezade et al., 2024 ) , bug localization ( Hossain et al., 2024 ) , and code completion ( Li et al., 2024b ) . Recent instruction-following models have further improved performance, particularly in generative settings, and have become an important class of methods for both code understanding and generation.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)现在被广泛用于源代码任务(冯等人,2020年;王等人,2021年;陈等人,2021年;许等人,2022年),包括代码搜索(李等人,2024年a),代码汇总(艾哈迈德等人,2024年),克隆检测(Khajezade等人,2024年),bug本地化(Hossain等人,2024年),代码完成(李等人,2024年b). 最近遵循的教学模式进一步提高了性能,特别是在基因环境中,并且成为了代码理解和生成的重要方法类别.

blocks.en: These advances are consistent with the naturalness hypothesis: human-written code is repetitive and statistically predictable, which makes language modeling useful for software artifacts ( Hindle et al., 2012 ; Allamanis et al., 2018 ) . Source code also contains natural-language information, particularly in identifiers. We use lexical information to refer to the information conveyed by the words in those identifiers. Such information is often useful rather than spurious by default: descriptive names can support human comprehension ( Schankin et al., 2018 ) , and high-quality lexical information and consistent coding styles can also facilitate models’ processing of well-written code ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 这些进步与自然论假说是一致的:人写代码是重复的,统计学上可以预测的,这使得语言建模对软件文物有用(Hindle等人,2012年;Allamanis等人,2018年). 源代码还包含自然语言信息,特别是标识符中的信息. 我们使用词汇信息来指代这些识别符中的词语所传递的信息。 这类信息往往有用,而不是默认的虚假:描述性名称可以支持人类理解(Schankin等人,2018年),高质量的词汇信息和一致的编码风格也可以促进模型对写得好代码的处理(Jiang等人,2024年;Shi等人,2022年).

blocks.en: The formal semantics of a program, however, are not identical to the distributional regularities of the corpus in which it appears. For identifiers eligible for consistent alpha-renaming, lexical content can change without changing program behavior. Prior work has shown that code models can nevertheless be fragile under lexical perturbations ( Yan and Li, 2021 ; Yang et al., 2024c ) . Figure 1 , for example, shows summaries that follow identifier meanings even when those meanings conflict with the implementation. We call this behavior lexical overemphasis (or, metaphorically, lexical superstition ): disproportionate sensitivity to identifier-level cues when task-relevant program structure is held constant. Our central questions are therefore: Do the evaluated LLMs overemphasize lexical information during code comprehension, and, if so, to what extent and in what manner?
blocks.zh: 然而,一个方案的正式语义与它所出现的本体的分布规律不同。 对于符合一致α-重命名条件的标识符,词典内容可以在不改变程序行为的情况下改变. 先前的研究表明,在词汇扰动下,代码模型仍然可能很脆弱(Yan and Li, 2021;Yang等人, 2024c.). 例如,图1显示的是,即使标识符的含义与执行相冲突,也遵循标识符的含义。 我们称这个行为语法过度强调(或,比喻性,语法迷信) :当任务相关程序结构保持恒定时,对标识级提示的敏感度不相称. 因此,我们的中心问题是: 所评价的有限责任公司是否在理解代码时过分强调词汇信息,如果是的话,在多大程度上以及以何种方式强调?

blocks.en: This question matters because benchmark performance may not fully characterize behavior when naming quality differs from the benchmark distribution. If a model assigns excessive weight to identifier cues, its reliability may decline on poorly named, anonymized, decompiled, or deliberately misleading code.
blocks.zh: 这个问题很重要,因为基准性能在命名质量与基准分布不同时可能不能充分描述行为特征. 如果一个模型给标识提示分配了过度的权重,其可靠性可能会在命名不当、匿名、解编或故意误导码上下降。

blocks.en: Because LLMs are trained on observational corpora, exploiting correlations between names and code behavior is expected and often beneficial. The reliability question is whether this dependence remains calibrated when the cues are missing or conflict with the implementation. This distinction matters because strong benchmark performance may be interpreted as evidence of code understanding or reasoning ( Gu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Ni et al., 2024 ) , while models are increasingly considered for consequential tasks such as code review and vulnerability detection. Controlled counterexamples can reveal failure modes that ordinary test distributions may not expose.
blocks.zh: 由于LLMS接受关于观察性公司(Observatora)的训练,利用名字与代码行为之间的关联是预期的,而且往往是有益的. 可靠性问题在于,在线索缺失时,这种依赖性是否仍然得到调整,还是与执行相冲突。 这种区分很重要,因为强基准性能可能被解释为代码理解或推理的证据(Gu等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年;Ni等人,2024年),而模型则越来越多地被考虑用于诸如代码审查和脆弱性检测等相应的任务. 被控制的反例可以揭示出普通测试分布可能不暴露的故障模式.

blocks.en: Dependence is therefore not a binary attribute. Our purpose is not to reject software naturalness or to require models to ignore identifiers. Instead, we systematically characterize how model behavior changes as lexical cues move from informative to absent and then misleading, while data flow, control flow, and algorithmic structure remain unchanged.
blocks.zh: 因此依赖性不是一个二进制属性. 我们的目的不是拒绝软件的自然性,也不是要求模型忽略标识符. 相反,我们系统地将模型行为的变化定性为语法提示从信息化到缺失,然后误导,而数据流、控制流和算法结构则保持不变。

blocks.en: We investigate this question with Face/Off , an evaluation framework based on semantics-preserving identifier transformations. We characterize how pervasive lexical sensitivity is across the evaluated models and tasks, test its persistence under representative interventions, and discuss possible contributing mechanisms more tentatively. To distinguish the loss of a task-relevant lexical cue from reliance on a cue that is unnecessary for the answer, we additionally conduct a targeted type-inference control on samples whose types can be determined from local program evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们用Face/Off来调查这个问题,这是一个基于语义保留识别器转换的评价框架. 我们描述在所评价的模式和任务中如何普遍具有词汇敏感性,在具有代表性的干预下检验其持久性,并更暂时地讨论可能的贡献机制。 为了区分与任务相关的语法提示的丢失与对答案不必要的提示的依赖,我们还对根据当地程序证据可以确定种类的样本进行有针对性的类型推断控制。

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1. LLMs for Code
blocks.zh: 2.1. 代码法学硕士

blocks.en: Learning-based methods for code have evolved from statistical and recurrent models to Transformer-based pre-trained models and instruction-following LLMs. These models are used in tasks such as code generation, completion, and vulnerability detection.
blocks.zh: 以学习为基础的编码方法已从统计模式和经常模式演变为以变形器为基础的预先培训模式和学习跟踪法学硕士。 这些模型被用于代码生成,完成和脆弱性检测等任务.

blocks.en: Early Transformer-based approaches adapted language models to code through additional pre-training, as in CodeBERT ( Feng et al., 2020 ) and Codex ( Chen et al., 2021 ) . Other work incorporates program structure, including graph, control-flow, and data-flow information ( Wei and Li, 2017 ; Guo et al., 2021 ; Ma et al., 2023 ) . More recent instruction-following model families, including GPT ( Tang et al., 2024 ; Achiam et al., 2023 ) , DeepSeek ( Guo et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ) , StarCoder ( Li et al., 2023 ) , and Qwen ( Yang et al., 2024a ; Yang et al., 2024b ) , support a broad range of code tasks in zero- and few-shot settings.
blocks.zh: 基于变形器的早期方法通过额外的前期训练使语言模型适应编码,如CodeBERT(冯等人,2020年)和Codex(陈等人,2021年). 其他工作包含程序结构,包括图,控制流,以及数据流信息(Wei和Li,2017;Guo等人,2021;Ma等人,2023). 较近期的教学模式家庭,包括GPT(Tang等人,2024年;Achiam等人,2023年),DeepSeek(Guo等人,2023年)。 2024; 朱等, 2024), 星编. (Li等人,2023年),和Quen(Yang等人,2024a; Yang et al., 2024b ),支持在零镜头和几镜头设置中广泛的代码任务.

blocks.en: Despite this progress, code models retain limitations in generation accuracy, robustness ( Bielik and Vechev, 2020 ) , security and data contamination ( Das et al., 2025 ; Magar and Schwartz, 2022 ) , interpretability, and data bias ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但代码模型在生成准确性,稳健性(Bielik and Vechev, 2020),安全和数据污染(Das等人,2025年;Magar and Schwartz, 2022年),可解释性和数据偏差(Jiang等人, 2024年)方面仍然有局限性.

blocks.en: 2.2. Code Naturalness, Shortcut Learning, and Program Comprehension
blocks.zh: 2.2. 守则自然性、快捷学习和方案理解

blocks.en: The naturalness hypothesis holds that human-written software is sufficiently repetitive and predictable to be modeled statistically ( Hindle et al., 2012 ) ; this observation underpins much work on machine learning for code ( Allamanis et al., 2018 ) . It does not, however, imply that every distributionally predictive feature is necessary for a task’s semantics. For a conditional model p ⁡ ( y ∣ x ) p(y\mid x) , identifier words may improve prediction because they correlate with behavior in ordinary corpora, even when a consistent renaming leaves the relevant program behavior unchanged. Our study does not dispute the usefulness of these correlations. It examines their reliability when lexical cues and program structure are experimentally placed in conflict.
blocks.zh: 自然论假说认为,人写软件具有足够的重复性和可预测性,可以进行统计模型化(Hindle等人,2012年);这一观察支撑了机器学习代码的许多工作(Allamanis等人,2018年). 然而,这并不意味着任务语义需要每一种分布预测特征。 对于一个有条件的模型p ⁡ (y ∣ x) p (y\mid x),标识词可能会改进预测,因为它们与普通蝎子中的行为相关,即使一个一致的重命名让相关的程序行为保持不变. 我们的研究并不质疑这些相互关系的效用。 当词汇提示和程序结构在实验中处于冲突状态时,它审查它们的可靠性。

blocks.en: This distinction parallels research on shortcut learning. Across machine learning, models can perform well on standard test distributions by using features that cease to be reliable under controlled or shifted conditions ( Geirhos et al., 2020 ) . In natural-language inference, for example, controlled counterexamples have been used to distinguish correct predictions based on intended relations from predictions based on fallible lexical and syntactic heuristics ( McCoy et al., 2019 ) . Face/Off applies the same diagnostic principle to code: semantics-preserving renaming holds the program structure fixed while varying one family of predictive cues. This connection motivates our experimental logic, but we limit our claims to the evaluated tasks, models, and transformations.
blocks.zh: 这一区别与关于捷径学习的研究平行. 在整个机器学习过程中,模型通过使用在控制或转移条件下不再可靠的特性,可以在标准测试分布上表现良好(Geirhos等人,2020年)。 例如,在自然语言推论中,控制反例被用于区分基于预期关系的正确预测和基于可谬误的词汇学和合成heuristics的预测(McCoy等人,2019年). Face/Off对代码应用相同的诊断原理:语义-保留重命名持有程序结构固定,同时改变一个预测提示的家族. 这种连接激发了我们的实验逻辑,但我们的主张仅限于被评价的任务,模型和转变.

blocks.en: Identifier information is also important in human program comprehension. Descriptive identifiers can accelerate semantic-defect detection, with effects that depend on the comprehension task and developer experience ( Schankin et al., 2018 ) . Program-comprehension research likewise shows that programmers use recognizable code “beacons,” that misleading beacons can induce false initial interpretations ( Wiedenbeck, 1991 ) , and that procedural relations such as control flow contribute to experts’ mental representations ( Pennington, 1987 ) . Field observations further show that professional comprehension extends beyond source text to browsers, documentation, and development tools ( Xia et al., 2018 ) . Thus, neither humans nor models should be expected to ignore names. The relevant question is how conclusions are revised when a useful cue conflicts with other available evidence.
blocks.zh: 识别信息对人类程序理解也很重要。 描述性标识符可以加速语义缺陷检测,其效果取决于理解任务和开发者经验(Schankin等人,2018年). 方案综合研究同样表明,程序员使用可识别代码 " Beacons " ,误导信标可诱发虚假的初步解释(Wiedenbeck,1991年),控制流等程序关系有助于专家的精神表达(Pennington,1987年)。 现场观测进一步显示,专业理解超越了源文本,文档,开发工具(Xia等人,2018年). 因此,不应期望人类或模型忽视名字。 相关的问题是,当一个有用的提示与其他现有证据发生冲突时,如何修订结论。

blocks.en: 2.3. Code Perturbation
blocks.zh: 2.3. 代码干扰

blocks.en: Code perturbation modifies selected properties of a program to observe a model’s response, often while preserving functionality. Perturbation methods can be organized by model access (white-box or black-box) and by the transformed program feature, such as identifiers or coding style.
blocks.zh: 代码扰动会修改一个程序的选定属性,以观察模型的响应,经常在保留功能的同时. 扰动方法可以通过模式访问(white-box或black-box)和转换后的程序特性,如标识符或编码风格来组织.

blocks.en: In code intelligence, code perturbation is widely used in attack-and-defense and robustness studies ( Du et al., 2023 ) . Because white-box methods require model access that is not always available, many studies use black-box approaches. Notable identifier-based attacks include MHM ( Zhang et al., 2020 ) , ACCENT ( Zhou et al., 2022 ) , WIR-Random ( Zeng et al., 2022 ) , and ALERT ( Yang et al., 2022 ) . Style-transfer methods insert dead code ( Na et al., 2023 ) or replace loop structures ( Li et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 在代码智能中,代码扰动被广泛用于攻击防御和强性研究(Du等人,2023年). 由于白盒方法需要模式访问,而模式访问并不总是可用的,许多研究使用黑盒方法. 基于识别特征的显著攻击包括MHM(张等人,2020年),ACCENT(周等人,2022年),WIR-Random ( Zen等人,2022年),和ALERT(杨等人,2022年). 样式转移方法插入死码(Na等人,2023年)或替换循环结构(Li等人,2022年).

blocks.en: Beyond adversarial contexts, code perturbation serves as a tool for probing model behaviors ( Dinh et al., 2023 ; Hooda et al., 2024 ) . Lexical perturbation has recently gained attention: Yang et al. examine its role in adversarial settings ( Yan and Li, 2021 ; Yang et al., 2024c ; Fang et al., 2024 ) , Gao et al. apply counterfactual analysis ( Gao et al., 2023b ) , and Hu et al. analyze naming quality ( Hu et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 除了对抗性背景之外,代码扰动还成为探究模型行为的工具(Dinh等人,2023年;Hooda等人,2024年)。 最近,表征扰动引起了注意: 杨等. (Yan和Li,2021年;Yang等人,2024年c;Fang等人,2024年c) 应用反事实分析(Gao等人,2023b)和Hu等人。 分析命名质量(Hu等人,2024年).

blocks.en: Although prior works have recognized the importance of lexical information for code comprehension, many study identifier perturbations in attack-and-defense or robustness settings. Our work is closely connected to this literature: we share semantics-preserving transformations, while using representative mitigation strategies in RQ3 as diagnostic interventions rather than as candidates for a state-of-the-art defense. Their role is to test whether the lexical influence characterized in RQ2 can be readily suppressed.
blocks.zh: 虽然先前的著作认识到词汇信息对于代码理解的重要性,但许多著作研究了攻击和防御或强健环境下的识别符扰动。 我们的工作与这个文献密切相关:我们分享语义学-保留转变,同时使用RQ3中有代表性的缓解策略作为诊断干预,而不是作为最先进的防御的候选者. 它们的作用是检验RQ2中描述的词典影响能否轻易压制.

blocks.en: In RQ1 and RQ2, identifier renaming is a controlled probe for characterizing how the quality and content of lexical information affect model interpretation. Rather than optimizing an attack or a defense, we compare a progressive spectrum of naming conditions and analyze both the magnitude and direction of changes in model responses. These analyses examine whether model behavior is anchored more strongly in identifier-level cues than in the unchanged program structure.
blocks.zh: 在RQ1和RQ2中,标识符重命名是一种可控探针,用于描述词典信息的质量和内容如何影响模型解释. 我们不是优化攻击或防御,而是比较一系列渐进的命名条件,分析模型反应变化的规模和方向. 这些分析研究了模型行为是否比没有改变的程序结构更强烈地扎根于标识级提示.

blocks.en: The remaining performance gaps show that lexical overemphasis persists across the tested models and methods, without implying that every possible intervention must fail.
blocks.zh: 其余的绩效差距表明,在经过检验的模式和方法中,语法上的过分强调仍然存在,但并不意味着所有可能的干预都必须失败。

blocks.en: Accordingly, our contribution is complementary to attack-and-defense research. We borrow relevant perturbation and mitigation techniques but employ them in a progressive, diagnostic study of lexical reliance.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们的贡献是对攻击和防卫研究的补充。 我们借用了相关的扰动和缓解技术,但在对学说依赖性进行渐进的诊断性研究中加以应用。

blocks.en: 3. Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3. 实验设置

blocks.en: 3.1. Research Questions
blocks.zh: 3.1. 研究问题

blocks.en: We organize the study around three research questions. RQ1 measures sensitivity to naming quality across the evaluated models and tasks; RQ2 examines whether misleading names directionally affect model outputs; and RQ3 uses mitigation attempts to probe the persistence of the observed sensitivity.
blocks.zh: 我们围绕着三个研究问题组织研究。 RQ1衡量所有被评价的模型和任务对命名质量的敏感性;RQ2研究误导性名称是否定向影响模型输出;RQ3使用缓解尝试来探究观测到的敏感性的持久性.

blocks.en: RQ1: To what extent does identifier naming quality influence LLM performance on the evaluated code-comprehension tasks?
blocks.zh: RQ1:标识符命名质量在多大程度上影响LLM性能对被评价的代码综合任务?

blocks.en: RQ1 compares performance under progressive naming conditions while holding the eligible program structure and behavior fixed. It tests how broadly the pattern recurs across the models, architectures, and tasks included in this study.
blocks.zh: RQ1比较了渐进命名条件下的性能,同时将符合条件的程序结构和行为固定. 它检验这种模式在研究所包含的模型、架构和任务中重复的程度。

blocks.en: RQ2: In what manner does identifier information influence LLM code comprehension?
blocks.zh: RQ2:标识信息如何影响LLM代码理解?

blocks.en: Performance degradation alone does not show how names affect a model’s interpretation. RQ2 therefore tests whether outputs move in the direction suggested by misleading identifiers, rather than merely changing under a distribution shift. Figure 1 provides an initial example; the experiments examine whether related directional patterns appear in the evaluated tasks.
blocks.zh: 单是性能退化并不能说明名字如何影响模型的解释。 因此,RQ2检验产出是否向误导识别器建议的方向移动,而不是仅仅在分配变化下变化。 图1提供了一个初步的例子;实验研究了相关方向模式是否出现在被评价的任务中.

blocks.en: RQ3: What do mitigation attempts reveal about the persistence of lexical overemphasis in current LLMs?
blocks.zh: RQ3: 缓解努力揭示出当前有限责任公司中长期存在的词典过分强调现象是什么?

blocks.en: RQ3 extends RQ2 by testing whether representative prompt- and fine-tuning-based interventions readily suppress the observed lexical influence. We monitor both overall performance and the gap between naming conditions; a persistent gap indicates that the behavior is not readily mitigated by the evaluated interventions. The scope of this inference is discussed in Threats to Validity.
blocks.zh: RQ3通过测试具有代表性的即时和微调干预是否容易抑制观察到的词汇影响来扩展RQ2. 我们监测总体业绩和命名条件之间的差距;持续的差距表明,受评价的干预措施无法轻易减轻行为。 这一推断的范围在 " 对有效性的威胁 " 中讨论。

blocks.en: 3.2. Terminologies
This section defines the terms used in our experimental design.
blocks.zh: 本节定义了我们实验设计中使用的术语.

blocks.en: 3.2.1. Semantics of Code
blocks.zh: 3.2.1. 守则的语义

blocks.en: In this study, the relevant preservation criterion is contextual operational behavior: an eligible transformation leaves control flow, data flow, operations, literals, and interactions with the surrounding context unchanged. We use functionality more narrowly for the observable input–output mapping, including relevant effects on external state; two implementations may therefore provide the same functionality while differing internally. For the cases considered here, controlled alpha-renaming preserves both. We exclude boundary cases in which names can affect dynamic resolution or external interaction, and verify that no other program construct changes by checking AST identity modulo the renamed identifier tokens.
blocks.zh: 在本研究中,相关的保存标准是上下文操作行为:符合条件的转换会留下控制流,数据流,操作,文字,以及与周围上下文的相互作用不变. 我们更狭义地使用功能来进行可观测到的投入-产出映射,包括对外部状态的相关影响;因此,两个实施可能提供相同的功能,而内部则有所不同。 对于这里考虑的案例,受控制的α重命名保留了两者. 我们排除了可以影响动态解析或外部交互的边界案例,并且通过检查AST身份调制重命名的标识符来验证没有其他程序构造变化.

blocks.en: 3.2.2. Lexical Information of Code
blocks.zh: 3.2.2. 法典的文字资料

blocks.en: The lexical information in this study is the additional information conveyed by the natural-language words in identifiers. Identifiers have both a nominal role in the program and a human-facing descriptive role. For identifiers that satisfy the eligibility rules of Face/Off, consistently renaming a binding and all of its references preserves the program’s operational semantics, although it can change readability and the expectations of a human or model reader.
blocks.zh: 本研究中的词典信息是标识符中自然语词传递的额外信息. 身份识别器在节目中既具有名义角色,也具有人气化的描述角色. 对于符合Face/Off资格规则的识别器,一致地重新命名一个约束性,其所有参考文献都保留了程序的操作语义,虽然它可以改变可读性以及人或模型阅读器的期望.

blocks.en: We therefore use identifier naming information as an alternative term for lexical information. Calling this information semantics-preserving under renaming does not mean that names are useless; it means that, for the transformations studied here, their descriptive content is not required to preserve the executed behavior.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们使用标识符命名信息作为词汇信息的替代术语。 在重命名下称这个信息语义-保存并不意味着名称是无用的;这意味着,对于这里研究的转换,其描述性内容不需要保存被执行的行为.

blocks.en: 3.2.3. "Semantics" of Non-Self-Contained Code Snippets
blocks.zh: 3.2.3. 非自定义密码片段的“语义”

blocks.en: We call a snippet self-contained when the bindings needed to interpret the transformed code are defined within the supplied snippet. A non-self-contained snippet may depend on external functions, attributes, or variables whose behavior cannot be determined from the snippet alone. Such examples are common in datasets including CodeSearchNet ( Husain et al., 2019 ) . Models may use names and surrounding context as evidence about these unresolved dependencies, but the supplied snippet does not by itself establish their behavior. We therefore restrict the standard Face/Off transformation to eligible locally bound identifiers and examine external identifiers separately in Section 4.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们称片段是自成一体的,当解释变形码所需的约束在所提供的片段内被定义. 非自成一体的片段可能依赖于外部函数,属性,或者其行为不能单从片段决定的变量. 这些例子在包括CodeSearchNet(Husain等人,2019年)在内的数据集中常见. 模型可能使用名称和周围上下文作为这些尚未解决的依赖性的证据,但所提供的片断本身并不能证明他们的行为. 因此,我们把标准Face/Off转换限制在符合当地条件的标识符上,并在第4.2节中单独审查外部标识符。

blocks.en: 3.3. Method: Face/Off
blocks.zh: 3.3. 方法:面/面

blocks.en: Based on these considerations, we design an evaluation framework called Face/Off to examine how model behavior changes under controlled variation in identifier information. For identifiers that meet the eligibility conditions, consistent renaming preserves operational behavior while changing the lexical cues available to the model.
blocks.zh: 基于这些考虑,我们设计了一个名为Face/Off的评价框架,以审查模型行为在识别信息控制变异下的变化. 对于符合资格条件的标识符,一致的重命名保留了操作行为,同时改变模型可用的词汇提示.

blocks.en: Figure 2. The Face/Off evaluation framework, illustrated with a code snippet under different naming schemes. The Confusing condition uses identifiers from an unrelated donor snippet. For eligible renamings, the lexical “face” changes while operational behavior is preserved. The schematic diagram of the Face/Off evaluation framework.
blocks.zh: 图 2. Face/Off评价框架,用不同命名办法下的代码片段来说明。 混淆条件使用一个无关捐助者片段的标识符。 对于符合资格的更名,在保留业务行为的同时,词汇“面”会改变。 Face/Off评价框架的图表。

blocks.en: Perturbative naming . This condition replaces identifiers with semantically similar alternatives and retains naturalness as a selection criterion. We sample replacements using CodeBERT ( Feng et al., 2020 ) representations rather than optimizing them against the evaluated model through M–H sampling ( Zhang et al., 2020 ) or evolutionary search ( Yang et al., 2022 ) . It provides a reference for relatively mild lexical variation.
blocks.zh: 扰动命名. 这一条件用非常相似的替代品取代了标识符,并保留自然性作为选择标准. 我们使用CodeBERT(冯等人,2020年)的表示法来进行抽样替换,而不是通过M-H取样(张等人,2020年)或进化搜索(杨等人,2022年)来对照评价模型来优化它们. 它为相对温和的词典变化提供了参考.

blocks.en: Anonymous naming . This condition replaces eligible identifiers with systematic placeholders such as func0 , func1 , var0 , and var1 . The placeholders remove most descriptive content without intentionally pointing toward an unrelated function, providing a reference between informative and misleading names.
blocks.zh: 匿名命名 。 这个条件用系统化的占位符,如 func0 , func1 , var0 , 和 var1 等来取代合格的标识符. 占位符去掉大多数描述性内容,而无意指向无关的功能,提供了信息化和误导性名称之间的参考.

blocks.en: Confusing naming , or targeted naming. This condition tests whether identifiers drawn from another snippet can direct model outputs toward the meanings associated with that snippet. We call the donor snippet the target code and construct the mapping using identifier type and order of appearance.
blocks.zh: 混淆命名,或定向命名. 这个条件检验从另一个片段抽取的标识符是否能够将模型输出指向与片段相关的含义. 我们称捐赠者为片断目标代码,并使用标识类型和外观顺序构建绘图.

blocks.en: Shuffling naming . This scheme is used only for the exploratory analysis in Section 7.2 ; it is not part of the standard Face/Off evaluation. It permutes the identifier mapping while retaining the same identifier set.
blocks.zh: 抖动的命名。 这一办法仅用于第7.2节的探索性分析;它不是标准面/面评价的一部分。 它使标识符映射永久化,同时保留相同的标识符集.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 2 , Face/Off presents the same eligible program under progressively less informative and then misleading naming conditions. Its lexical “face” changes while the controlled alpha-renaming preserves operational behavior.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,Face/Off在信息逐渐减少,然后误导性命名条件下,呈现相同的合格程序. 它的词典“面”变化,而受控制的α重命名保留了操作行为.

blocks.en: We denote by { C A , D A } \{C_{A},D_{A}\} the source code and its corresponding documentation. Let C A B C_{A}^{B} denote the result of confusing renaming of C A C_{A} using C B C_{B} as the target code. ℳ ⁡ ( C ) \mathcal{M}(C) denotes the model’s output on C C .
blocks.zh: 我们表示{CA,DA} QQC_{A},D_{A}\} 源代码及其相应的文档. 让CABCQQAQB}表示以CBCQB}作为目标代码的CACQA}的混淆重命名的结果. MQQ (C)\mathcal{M}(C)表示该模型在CC上的输出.

blocks.en: Accompanying text is handled by task rather than by renaming every identifier-like word. For the CodeSearchNet-based tasks, AST-based mappings transform the code; when a naming condition changes the subject-function name, an exact occurrence of that name in the corresponding description or reference follows the same mapping. Parameter names and other prose remain unchanged because they may convey task-relevant information. In code–document matching, only the positive description is synchronized; random negative descriptions remain unchanged. Transformation failures were manually completed so that all conditions retain the same 600 samples, and the resulting descriptions were inspected.
blocks.zh: 配套文字由任务处理,而不是重新命名每一个类似标识的单词. 对于基于 CodeSearchNet 的任务,基于 AST 的映射会转换代码;当一个命名条件改变主题函数名称时,在相应的描述或参考中该名称的确切发生会遵循相同的映射. 参数名称和其他旁白保持不变,因为它们可能传递与任务有关的信息。 在代码–文档匹配中,只有正向描述是同步的;随机负向描述保持不变. 转换失败是人工完成的,以便所有条件都保留同样的600个样品,并检查了由此产生的说明。

blocks.en: For HumanEval, the natural-language problem description is excluded from the input. The model receives only the transformed function signature and a truncated body prefix; the same mapping covers definitions and references in the prefix and held-out completion, and the evaluation entry point follows the transformed function name. Unit tests are withheld and used only for functional evaluation.
blocks.zh: 对于HumanEval,自然语言问题描述被排除在输入之外. 该模型只接收已变换的函数签名和一个切换体前缀;同样的映射覆盖了前缀中的定义和引用以及挂载完成,评价切入点遵循已变换的函数名称. 单位检验不进行,只用于功能评价.

blocks.en: Confusing renaming introduces identifiers from a randomly selected donor snippet C B C_{B} while retaining the eligible implementation of C A C_{A} ; donors come from a different class when labels are available, and identifiers are mapped by type and order of appearance. We do not impose a subjective semantic-dissimilarity criterion, so incidental similarities are part of the sampling procedure and may weaken or strengthen individual contrasts. Section 5.1 tests whether outputs move toward the meanings associated with the sampled donors.
blocks.zh: 混淆重命名引入了随机选择的捐助方片段C B QQB}的标识符,同时保留CA CQQA}的合格执行;当标签可用时,捐助方来自不同的类别,标识符按类型和外观顺序绘制. 我们不强加主观的语义-分歧标准,因此偶然的相似性是采样程序的一部分,可能削弱或强化个体的对比. 第5.1节检验产出是否走向与抽样捐助者有关的含义。

blocks.en: In the standard Face/Off setting, external identifiers remain unchanged because their bindings and behavior may not be available in the snippet. Section 4.2 examines them separately with the extended construction and an insertion control.
blocks.zh: 在标准Face/Off设置中,外部标识符保持不变,因为其约束和行为可能无法在片断中获取. 第4.2节与扩展构件和插入控制分开审查。

blocks.en: 3.4. Tasks

Code-Document Matching asks whether a code snippet and a brief description correspond. Given a pair ( C i , D j ) (C_{i},D_{j}) , the model outputs a binary decision. We use the original pair ( C A , D A ) (C_{A},D_{A}) as a positive sample and a randomly selected irrelevant description D B D_{B} to construct the negative pair ( C A , D B ) (C_{A},D_{B}) ; text handling follows Section 3.3 . As shown in Table 2 , the evaluated models obtain a 100 % 100\% true negative rate (TNR) for these random pairs under the Original condition, indicating that the sampled negatives are readily distinguishable in that setting.

blocks.en: We report classification accuracy, along with true positive rate (TPR) and true negative rate (TNR). The CodeSearchNet dataset ( Husain et al., 2019 ) is used here, as well as for Code Search and Code Summarization. To prevent interference from other information, we modify comments by removing structured parameter-list sections, usage examples, URLs, and other content likely to provide direct answer cues.
blocks.zh: 我们报告分类准确性,以及真实正率和真实负率。 代码SearchNet数据集(Husain等人,2019年)在此使用,也用于代码搜索和代码汇总. 为防止来自其他信息的干扰,我们通过删除结构化的参数列表部分,使用示例,URL,以及其他可能提供直接答案提示的内容来修改注释.

blocks.en: Code Search evaluates a model’s ability to retrieve code from a natural-language query. Given D = { ( C i , D i ) } D=\{(C_{i},D_{i})\} , we encode code and text separately and rank each C j C_{j} for query D i D_{i} by the similarity between ℳ ⁡ ( C j ) \mathcal{M}(C_{j}) and ℳ ⁡ ( D i ) \mathcal{M}(D_{i}) .

blocks.en: Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) is used as the evaluation metric ( Lu et al., 2021 ; Fan et al., 2025 ) , which measures the average of the reciprocal ranks of results for a set of queries.
blocks.zh: 平均对等排名(MRR)被用作评价衡量标准(Lu等人,2021年;Fan等人,2025年),衡量一组查询的对等排名结果的平均值。

blocks.en: Code summarization requires the model to generate a one-sentence natural-language summary for a given code snippet C i C_{i} . Unlike code–document matching, it evaluates an open-ended description rather than a binary decision.
blocks.zh: 代码汇总要求模型为给定代码片断C i C_{i}生成一个一判决自然语言摘要. 与代码–文档匹配不同,它评价一个开放式描述而不是二进制决定.

blocks.en: Following prior work ( Lu et al., 2021 ; Gao et al., 2023a ) , we evaluate the output ℳ ⁡ ( C i ) \mathcal{M}(C_{i}) against the reference description D i D_{i} using BLEU ( Papineni et al., 2002 ) (with 4-gram precision), ROUGE-L ( Lin, 2004 ) (with F1 reported as the primary metric), and METEOR ( Banerjee and Lavie, 2005 ) . Here, D i D_{i} is an evaluation reference rather than part of the model input, and its treatment follows Section 3.3 .
blocks.zh: 继先前的工作(Lu et al.,2021;Gao et al.,2023a)之后,我们利用BLEU(Papineni et al.,2002年)(精确4克)、ROUGE-L(Lin,2004年)(F1报告为主要衡量标准)和METEOR(Banerjee和Lavie,2005年),对照参考说明D i D_{i)评估产出。 这里,D i D_{i}是一个评价参考,而不是模型输入的一部分,它的处理遵循第3.3节.

blocks.en: In Code Completion, the model receives a transformed function signature followed by a truncated prefix of the function body and generates the remainder of the solution. Input transformation and functional evaluation follow Section 3.3 .
blocks.zh: 在代码补全中,模型接收一个转换函数签名,然后是函数体的切换前缀,并生成剩余溶液. 投入转化和职能评价遵循第3.3节。

blocks.en: Functional correctness is evaluated using Pass@1 ( Guo et al., 2024 ; Roziere et al., 2023 ; Brown et al., 2020 ; Achiam et al., 2023 ) . We use the HumanEval dataset ( Chen et al., 2021 ) . Unlike the standard setting, we filter examples with sufficiently long solution code, randomly truncate the code, and append the first few lines of the canonical solution to the input so that both the supplied prefix and held-out completion contain at least one identifier.
blocks.zh: 使用Pass@1(Guo等人,2024年;Roziere等人,2023年;Brown等人,2020年;Achiam等人,2023年)评估功能正确性。 我们使用HumanEval数据集(Chen等人,2021年). 与标准设置不同的是,我们过滤具有足够长的解码的示例,随机切换代码,并在输入中附加犬科解码法的前几行,这样,所提供的前缀和被保持的完成都至少包含一个标识符.

blocks.zh: 深搜索码- 1.3B (郭 et等,2024) : 一个基础模型(1.3B参数)从头开始在2兆令牌上预先训练,并有一个16K窗口用于代码生成和填充.

blocks.en: 3.6. Prompting
We evaluate instruction-following LLMs through prompting, following their standard mode of use and without task-specific parameter updates.
blocks.zh: 我们通过提示、遵循其标准使用模式和不更新特定任务参数来评估指令跟踪 LLMs。

blocks.en: Figure 3. Two (abbreviated) examples of the prompt used in our experiments. Two abbreviated examples of the prompt used in our experiments.
blocks.zh: 图 3. 两个(略)例子说明我们实验中使用的迅速。 我们实验中使用的提示的两个缩略例子。

blocks.en: For code–document matching and code summarization, we use few-shot prompting as illustrated in Figure 3 . Prompt examples are randomly sampled from the training set. Unless otherwise specified, each prompt contains two examples; for code–document matching, these comprise one positive and one negative example. Following prior work ( Nijkamp et al., 2023 ) , we use the zero-shot setup shown in Figure 3 for code completion.
blocks.zh: 关于代码 - 文件匹配和代码汇总,我们使用图3所示的几发提示。 从培训集中随机抽取迅速的例子。 除非另有说明,否则每个提示包含两个示例;对于代码-文档匹配,这些示例包括一个正例和一个负例. 继先前的工作(Nijkamp等人,2023年)之后,我们使用图3显示的零镜头设置来完成代码.

blocks.en: 4. RQ1: Cross-Task Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4个 RQ1:跨任务评价

blocks.en: 4.1. Face/Off Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.1. 主要成果

blocks.en: We now summarize the setting of cross-task Face/Off evaluation with Table 1 , following the ideas and criteria mentioned above.
blocks.zh: 我们现在按照上述想法和标准,用表1概述交叉任务面/业务评价的设置。

blocks.en: Table 1. This table illustrates the correspondence between tasks, models and datasets used in this section. The upper section lists large language models evaluated using in-context learning, while the lower section details open-source models evaluated through fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 表1. 本表显示本节使用的任务、模型和数据集之间的对应关系。 上节列出使用内文学习来评价的大型语言模型,下节则详细列出通过微调评价的开源模型.

blocks.en: For each task, the naming conditions are derived from the same underlying samples. The controlled transformation is designed to vary eligible identifier information while retaining the other program content, thereby isolating this factor within the limits discussed in Section 3.3 and Threats to Validity.
blocks.zh: 对于每一项任务,命名条件都来自相同的基础样品. 控制下的转换旨在改变合格的识别信息,同时保留其他程序内容,从而在3.3节和对有效性的威胁所讨论的限度内将这一因素隔离开来.

blocks.en: 4.1.1. Code-Document Matching
blocks.zh: 4.1.1. 编码文件 匹配

blocks.en: Table 2 reports code-document matching accuracy. For each evaluated model, performance decreases from Original to Anonymous naming and decreases further under Confusing naming; Perturbative naming produces a smaller change.
blocks.zh: 表2报告编码文件匹配准确性。 对于每个被评价的模型,性能从原始命名降至匿名命名,并在混淆命名下进一步减少; 扰动命名产生较小的变化.

blocks.en: Table 2. Performance (shown in accuracy %) of various LLMs under different Face/Off schemes. Subscripts indicate corresponding true positive and true negative rates (TPR | | TNR).
blocks.zh: 图表 2. 不同面/面方案下各种有限责任公司的业绩(准确度%) 下标表示相应的真实正负率(TPR QQ TNR).

blocks.en: Examining TPR and TNR separately, TNR remains near 100 % 100\% in most conditions, whereas TPR accounts for most of the accuracy decline. The lower TNR under Confusing naming for some models also shows that donor identifiers can make a mismatched description appear more plausible. Section 5.1 examines this directional effect more directly.
blocks.zh: TPR和TNR分开检查,TNR在大多数条件下仍然接近100%的100QQ,而TPR则占准确度下降的大部分. 在混淆某些模型的命名下较低的TNR也表明,捐赠者识别符可以使不匹配的描述显得更合理. 第5.1节更直接地审查这一方向效应。

blocks.en: 4.1.2. Code Search
blocks.zh: 4.1.2. 代码搜索

blocks.en: Table 3 presents the MRR results for code search. Among the evaluated models, CodeBERT degrades the most, while GraphCodeBERT—using the same architecture but with additional data flow-based attention—performs similarly to the commercial-grade encoder Text-embedding-3 ( OpenAI, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 表3列出代码搜索的MRR结果。 在被评价的模型中,CodeBERT的降解程度最高,而GraphCodeBERT-使用相同的架构,但有额外的基于数据流的注意-其效法类似于商业级编码器Text-embedding-3(OpenAI, 2024).

blocks.en: Table 3. Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) results for code search and performance degradation ratios for two fine-tuned models and the encoding API under different Face/Off naming schemes.
blocks.zh: 图表 3. 两个经过微调的模型的代码搜索和性能退化率和不同面/面命名办法下的API编码均对等排名的结果。

blocks.en: All three renamed variants reduce MRR, with the largest decrease under Confusing naming. Because retrieval is based on encoder similarity, these results are consistent with lexical changes altering the relative positions of code and queries in the representation space. MRR alone, however, does not identify the direction or magnitude of the underlying embedding shifts.
blocks.zh: 所有三个重新命名的变体都减少了MRR,在Confuse命名下减少幅度最大. 由于检索是基于编码器的相似性,这些结果与改变代码和查询在表示空间的相对位置的词汇变化是一致的. 然而,单凭MRR并不能确定根本嵌入性转变的方向或程度。

blocks.en: 4.1.3. Code Summarization
blocks.zh: 4.1.3. 代码汇总

blocks.en: Table 4 reports average code-summarization scores. Instruction-following models are evaluated through few-shot prompting, whereas the smaller open-source models are fine-tuned. Every evaluated model scores below its Original condition after renaming, and Confusing naming yields the lowest score in each case.
blocks.zh: 表4报告平均代码汇总分数。 指令跟踪模型通过几发提示来评价,而较小的开源模型则经过微调. 每个被评价的模型在重命名后都会得低于其原状的分数,而混淆命名则在每种情况下得分最低.

blocks.en: Table 4. ROUGE-L F1 scores for code summarization of various LLMs under Face/Off framework. The upper section shows instruction-following models evaluated via in-context learning, and the lower section presents fine-tuned open-source models.
blocks.zh: 表4. ROUGE-L F1在Face/Off框架下各种LLMs的代码汇总得分. 上一节显示通过内文学习评价的遵循指令的模型,下一节介绍微调开源模型.

blocks.en: The same ordering appears for both instruction-following and fine-tuned models, although the absolute scores and the size of the decreases differ.
blocks.zh: 虽然绝对分数和减少的大小不同,但指导跟踪和微调模型的顺序相同。

blocks.en: 4.1.4. Code Completion
blocks.zh: 4.1.4. 守则的完成

blocks.en: Table 5 presents code completion performance of four LLMs across all Face/Off settings.
blocks.zh: 表5列出了所有Face/Off设置中四个LLM的代码完成性能.

blocks.en: Table 5. Pass@1 results for Code Completion and performance degradation ratios for evaluated LLMs under different Face/Off naming schemes.
blocks.zh: 图表 5. 在不同的面/面命名办法下,经过评价的LLMS的代码完成率和性能退化率的通过@1结果。

blocks.en: Code completion contains the clearest exceptions to the ordering observed in the other tasks. Anonymous naming sometimes performs better than Perturbative naming, and DeepSeek-Coder-V2 improves slightly over its Original score under Anonymous naming.
blocks.zh: 完成代码包含其他任务中遵守的订单最明显的例外. 匿名命名有时表现优于Perrurbative命名,DeepSeek-Coder-V2在匿名命名下略优于其原始得分.

blocks.en: We attribute this in part to the nature of the task. The identifiers being renamed constitute a relatively small portion of the supplied signature and partial function body, while literals, operations, and control/data-flow relations remain available. Because the HumanEval descriptions are not included in the model input, the reversal cannot be attributed to reliance on the natural-language problem statement. Anonymous naming supplies consistent neutral placeholders, whereas perturbative naming can introduce alternative lexical associations; we treat this explanation as a hypothesis rather than a separately identified causal result.
blocks.zh: 我们将此部分归因于任务的性质。 重新命名的标识符构成所提供签名和部分函数体中相对较小的一部分,而文字、操作和控制/数据流动关系仍然可用。 由于模型输入中没有HumanEval描述,因此逆转不能归因于依赖自然语言的问题说明. 匿名的命名提供一致的中性占位符,而扰动的命名可以引入替代的词典协会;我们把这种解释作为假设而不是单独确定的因果关系.

blocks.en: Confusing naming nevertheless produces the lowest Pass@1 for each evaluated model, with decreases ranging from 16.97% to 34.18% relative to Original.
blocks.zh: 然而,混淆命名后,每个评估的模型都产生最低的Pass@1,相对原型下降16.97%至34.18%。

blocks.en: Across the four tasks, removing or contradicting identifier information generally reduces performance, with task-specific exceptions in code completion. Section 4.4 summarizes these patterns and their scope.
blocks.zh: 在所有四项任务中,删除或与标识符信息相矛盾通常会降低性能,在代码完成方面有特定任务例外. 第4.4节概述了这些模式及其范围。

blocks.en: Prompt design can affect instruction-following models. As a sensitivity analysis, we evaluate GPT-3.5-turbo on code-document matching with zero-shot, one-shot, and two-shot configurations using different example combinations.
blocks.zh: 即时设计可以影响遵循指令的模型. 作为灵敏度分析,我们对GPT-3.5涡轮在密码文档上与零射,一射,二射配置进行比对,使用不同的示例组合.

blocks.en: Table 6. Effect of prompt settings on GPT-3.5-turbo in code–document matching. We report average accuracy, with subscripts indicating the corresponding true-positive and true-negative rates (TPR | | TNR).
blocks.zh: 图表 6. 编码-文件匹配中即时设置对GPT-3.5涡轮的影响。 我们报告平均准确性,下标显示相应的真实阳性和真实阴性率(TPR QQQ TNR)。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 6 , absolute accuracy varies across prompts, but all tested configurations retain the ordering Original > > Anonymous > > Confusing. This result shows that the pattern is not specific to the single prompt used in the main experiment; it does not establish invariance to prompt design more generally.
blocks.zh: 如表6所示,绝对准确度因提示而异,但所有测试的配置都保留顺序Original > > 匿名 > > 令人困惑 这一结果显示,该图案并不特指主实验中使用的单倍率;它并不确立更一般的倍率偏差,即时设计.

blocks.en: 4.2. Impact of External Identifiers
blocks.zh: 4.2. 外部识别器的影响

blocks.en: The standard experiments rename only eligible locally defined identifiers. External functions, attributes, and variables may also provide informative lexical cues, but their behavior is not defined within the snippet. We therefore examine them separately with an extended construction.
blocks.zh: 标准实验只重命名符合本地定义的标识符. 外部函数,属性,变量也可能提供信息词汇提示,但其行为在片段内没有定义. 因此,我们通过扩建工程分别审查这些建议。

blocks.en: As discussed in Section 3.2.3 , directly renaming unresolved external identifiers can change the referenced object. The extended construction uses an added binding block to preserve the original behavior. Because the inserted code changes the program representation, this construction is less strictly controlled than local alpha-renaming.
blocks.zh: 如第3.2.3节所讨论的,直接重命名未解决的外部标识符可以改变引用对象. 扩展的建筑使用一个附加的绑定块来保存原始行为. 由于插入的代码会改变程序代表,因此这种构造比本地的α重命名控制得更少.

blocks.en: Figure 4. An example of decontextualizing an external variable or function by wrapping it in a local definition. The corresponding dead-code insertion used for the control condition is also illustrated. An example of our extended Face/Off together with the control group using dead code insertion.
blocks.zh: 图 4. 将一个外部变量或函数包成一个本地定义,从而将其解密的例子。 用于控制条件的对应死码插入也进行了说明. 我们的扩展面/面 以及使用死代码插入的控制组的例子 。

blocks.en: Figure 4 illustrates the extended construction. We rename an external identifier and insert a preceding assignment that binds the new local name to the original external object. This retains access to the same object while moving the original lexical cue out of its use sites.
blocks.zh: 图4说明了扩建工程的情况。 我们重命名一个外部标识符,并插入一个先前的任务,将新的本地名称绑定在原始外部对象上。 这保留了对同一对象的访问,同时将原始的词汇提示移出其使用站点.

blocks.en: The original external name therefore remains once in the binding block but is removed from its original use sites. This decontextualization tests whether relocating the cue changes model performance.
blocks.zh: 因此,原外部名称在装订区块中保留一次,但从原来的使用地点中删除。 这种解密测试是否移动提示会改变模型性能 。

blocks.en: Because the added binding block changes the syntax, the extended method is not directly comparable to the local alpha-renaming intervention. We include a control that inserts a structurally similar dead-code block without renaming ( Na et al., 2023 ) . This control estimates part of the insertion effect, although it cannot remove every difference between the conditions.
blocks.zh: 由于添加的绑定块会改变语法,所以扩展的方法不能直接与本地的α重命名干预相比. 我们包括一个不重命名而插入结构上类似的死码块的控制(Na等人,2023年)。 这种控制估计了插入效果的一部分,虽然它不能消除条件之间的所有差异.

blocks.en: We employ the extended Face/Off to evaluate various models on two tasks: code-document matching and code summarization. The results are shown in Table 7 .
blocks.zh: 我们使用扩展的Face/Off来评价各种模型的两种任务:代码文档匹配和代码汇总. 结果见表7。

blocks.en: Table 7. Re-evaluation on two tasks, illustrating further performance degradation from decontextualizing external variables. Performance in the Original condition provides a reference for the model’s response to dead-code insertion.
blocks.zh: 表7. 对两项任务的重新评价,说明外部变量脱文字的进一步性能退化。 原始条件中的性能为模型对死码插入的反应提供了参考.

blocks.en: After external identifiers are decontextualized, the table shows additional performance decreases for every evaluated model and task relative to the corresponding Anonymous-plus-dead-code condition. The size of this additional decrease varies across models and tasks.
blocks.zh: 外部标识符解密后,表格显示每个被评价模型和任务相对于相应的匿名加死码条件的额外性能下降. 这种额外减少的规模因模式和任务而异。

blocks.en: These results are consistent with external identifier names contributing to performance when they appear at their use sites. Because the intervention relocates rather than eliminates the names and introduces an added binding block, it provides supporting evidence rather than a clean estimate of the effect of all external identifiers. We therefore do not generalize this result to every identifier or external dependency.
blocks.zh: 这些结果与外部标识名称相一致,这些标识名称在使用地点出现时有助于业绩。 由于干预会转移而不是消除名称,并引入一个附加的绑定块,它提供了支持性证据,而不是对所有外部识别器效果的清洁估计. 因此,我们没有将这一结果概括到每一个识别特征或外部依赖。

blocks.en: 4.3. Targeted Type-Inference Semantic Control
blocks.zh: 4.3. 定向类型推论语义控制

blocks.en: The original four tasks can legitimately reward identifier information: descriptions, queries, and completions may be easier when names express intent. Their performance changes therefore do not alone distinguish disproportionate lexical reliance from the removal of information that the task ordinarily uses. We add a targeted control in which a selected variable’s type is already determined by literals, operations, collection construction, comparisons, or local control and data flow. This supplementary boundary-condition experiment asks whether the larger effects in the original tasks persist when the answer is locally recoverable without the target name; it is not a fifth task intended for direct cross-task comparison.
blocks.zh: 最初的四项任务可以合法地奖励识别信息:描述、查询和完成在姓名表明意图时可能比较容易。 因此,它们的业绩变化本身并不能将不相称的逻辑依赖与删除任务通常使用的信息区分开来。 我们添加一个目标控制,其中选定的变量类型已经由字词、操作、收集构造、比较或本地控制和数据流动决定。 这个补充的边界条件实验询问,当答案在没有目标名称的情况下可以在当地恢复时,原始任务中较大的效果是否继续存在;这不是第五项任务,意在直接进行跨任务比较.

blocks.en: We use the clean test split of ManyTypes4Py v0.7 ( Mir et al., 2021 ) . A conservative automatic screen retains targets whose assignments are locally type-determining without repository-level or external-API type knowledge. We remove direct type cues from annotations, type comments, comments, and function docstrings while retaining the surrounding program structure and non-target lexical context. The resulting set contains 317 target variables from 217 projects and 217 source files.
blocks.zh: 我们使用ManyTypes4Py v0.7(Mir等人,2021年)的清洁测试分解. 一个保守的自动屏幕保留着那些任务为本地类型测定而无寄存器级或外部API类型知识的目标. 我们从注释、类型评论、注释和函数符号串中删除直接类型提示,同时保留周围的程序结构和非目标语法上下文。 由此产生的一套包含217个项目的317个目标变量和217个源文件.

blocks.en: Each target yields three paired conditions. Original retains its name; Target-Anonymous replaces the target binding and its references with a collision-free placeholder; and Target-Confusing replaces the same binding and references with a real identifier associated with a conflicting top-level type. No other identifier, API, literal, or program relation is changed. The variants pass parsing, compilation, binding-occurrence, and alpha-equivalence checks.
blocks.zh: 每个目标产生三个配对条件. 原文保留其名称; 目标匿名用无碰撞的占位符取代目标绑定和引用; 目标协调用与冲突顶级类型相关的真实标识符取代相同的绑定和引用. 没有其它标识符、 API、 字面或程序关系更改 。 变体通过解析,编译,装订-误差,以及α等效性检查.

blocks.en: The prompt identifies one target variable in the sanitized code and asks for one of 15 normalized type labels. We evaluate GPT-3.5-turbo-0125 , GPT-4o-mini , and Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct ( Dubey and others, 2024 ) . 1 1 1 Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct was used as the closest available successor to the LLaMA3:70B-Instruct endpoint used in the main experiments. All conditions use the same prompt and temperature 0. We report target-level strict exact-match accuracy; paired confidence intervals are clustered by project, and McNemar tests are Holm-corrected within each model.
blocks.zh: 即时识别出一个在消毒码中的目标变量,并要求在15个普通类型标签中找到一个. 我们评价了GPT-3.5-turbo-0125,GPT-4o-mini,以及Llama-3.1-70B-指令(Dubey等人,2024年). 11 1 Llama-31-70B-指令被作为主要实验中使用的LLaMA3:70B-指令端点最接近的可获取的继任者. 所有条件都使用同样的即时温度和0. 我们报告目标级的严格精确匹配的准确性;配对的置信间隔按照项目分组,麦克尼马尔测试在每个模型内都是Holm校正的.

blocks.en: Table 8. Target-level strict exact-match accuracy for the type-inference semantic control. Each condition contains the same 317 targets.
blocks.zh: 图表 8. 目标级别 严格精确匹配的精确度,用于类型参考语义控制。 每个条件包含相同的317个目标.

blocks.en: Table 8 shows changes of − 3.2 -3.2 to + 2.2 +2.2 percentage points relative to Original, with different directions across models and conditions. None of the Anonymous–Original or Confusing–Original differences is significant after Holm correction. The only corrected significant contrast is GPT-4o-mini’s Confusing accuracy relative to Anonymous ( + 5.4 +5.4 points; project-clustered 95% CI [ + 1.2 , + 9.8 ] [+1.2,+9.8] ; Holm-adjusted p = .018 p=.018 ), opposite to a prediction that misleading names must consistently reduce accuracy. Errors and condition changes are concentrated in dict targets, whereas many primitive targets are at or near ceiling.
blocks.zh: 表8显示与原始数据相比,3.2-3.2至2.2+2.2个百分点的变化,模型和条件方向不同。 在Holm修正后,无一是匿名-原件或混淆-原件的差异。 唯一经过纠正的显著对比是GPT-4o-mini的混淆精度相对于匿名者(+ 5.4+5.4分;项目集群为95% CI [+1.2,+9.8] [+1.2,+9.8];Holm调整p=.018 p=.018),与误导名称必须持续降低精度的预测相反. 错误和条件变化集中在dict目标,而许多原始目标处于或接近上限.

blocks.en: Within this conservatively screened subset, where local semantic evidence suffices for the answer, changing only the target name has a smaller and less consistent effect than in the original four tasks. Names can still modulate individual predictions, particularly for composite types, but they are not the principal required evidence in this conservatively screened subset. This result confirms a boundary on the main finding rather than showing that models never use names or that the original tasks should be name-independent.
blocks.zh: 在这个保守筛选的子集中,当局部语义证据足以回答时,只改变目标名称的效果比最初的四项任务要小,也不太一致. 名称仍然可以调制单个预测,特别是对于复合类型,但它们不是这个保守筛选的子集中需要的主要证据. 这一结果证实了主要发现上的边界,而不是表明模型从不使用名称,或者最初的任务应该是名称独立的.

blocks.en: 4.4. Section Summary
blocks.zh: 4.4 节摘要

blocks.en: Figure 5 summarizes the cross-task results. Perturbative naming generally produces the smallest decrease, Anonymous naming a larger decrease, and Confusing naming the largest. Code completion departs from this ordering for Perturbative versus Anonymous naming, but Confusing remains the lowest-performing condition for each evaluated model.
blocks.zh: 图5总结了跨任务成果。 扰动性命名一般产生最小的下降,匿名性命名较大,混淆命名最大. 代码的完成偏离了对扰动命名和匿名命名的这一命令,但混淆仍然是每个被评价模型的最低性能条件。

blocks.en: Figure 5. Line chart display of Face/Off evaluation results. In the figure, circular data points represent larger instruction-following models, while square data points represent smaller open-source models. Note that in the code completion chart, we have partially reversed the order, and the considerations are discussed in 4.1.4 . Line chart display of Face/Off evaluation results. The trend lines on each chart generally show a downward trend from left to right, with only a few exceptions.

blocks.en: Overall, sensitivity to identifier quality is pervasive across the evaluated models and original four tasks. The targeted type-inference control confirms a boundary on its magnitude: in the conservatively screened subset, effects are smaller and directionally inconsistent when the answer is recoverable without the target name. RQ2 next asks whether the sensitivity observed in the original tasks is directional—that is, whether misleading names guide outputs toward the donor meaning—rather than treating performance changes alone as sufficient evidence of overemphasis.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,在评价的模型和最初的四项任务中,对标识质量的敏感性是普遍存在的。 目标类型推导控制确认其大小的边界:在保守筛选的子集中,当答案可以恢复而无目标名称时,效果较小,方向不一致. 接下来,RQ2询问,在最初的任务中观察到的敏感性是否是方向性的,也就是说,误导性名称是否引导产出走向捐助方的含义,而不是仅仅将绩效变化视为过分强调的充分证据。

blocks.en: 5. RQ2: Effect Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.五. RQ2:效果分析

blocks.en: RQ1 shows performance sensitivity under controlled naming changes, but it does not by itself distinguish loss of a useful cue from active guidance by a misleading one. RQ2 addresses this distinction by testing whether outputs move toward the semantics suggested by donor identifiers.
blocks.zh: RQ1在受控命名变化下显示性能敏感性,但是它本身并不区分一个有用提示的丢失和被误导者主动引导. RQ2通过测试产出是否转向捐助方识别符所建议的语义,解决了这种区别.

blocks.en: 5.1. Guiding Effect of Lexical Information
blocks.zh: 5.1. 文字资料的指导效果

blocks.en: We focus on Confusing naming, where C A B C_{A}^{B} retains the eligible implementation of program A A but receives identifiers sampled from program B B . RQ1 evaluates outputs against the correct target for A A ; here we additionally compare them with references associated with B B . A shift toward B B provides directional evidence that the donor identifiers influence the output, although it does not by itself identify the model’s internal mechanism.

blocks.en: Figure 7 shows an example whose original program computes mean absolute deviation. Under the original and anonymous settings, the model produces the correct solution. After confusing renaming introduces identifiers such as even_odd_count , the model instead generates code that counts odd and even numbers and returns the absolute difference between even_count and odd_count . Because the natural-language HumanEval description is not provided, this output reflects a conflict between the misleading identifier cues and the operations and data flow present in the partial code, with the generated continuation following the former. In the shuffling case, swapping mean and mean_absolute_deviation causes the model to return the wrong variable, consistent with interpreting that variable through its new name.
blocks.zh: 图7显示了一个其原始程序计算表示绝对偏差的例子. 在原始和匿名设置下,该模型产生正确的解决方案. 在混淆重命名引入偶数等标识符后,该模型会生成数为奇数和偶数的代码,并返回偶数和奇数的绝对差. 由于没有提供自然语言HumanEval描述,这一输出反映了误导的标识提示与部分代码中存在的操作和数据流之间的冲突,生成的续作跟随前者. 在洗牌案中,互换意指和意指的_absolute_deviation导致模型返回错误的变量,与通过新名称解释该变量一致.

blocks.en: In this example, the generated continuation follows the functionality suggested by the renamed identifiers despite conflicting evidence in the partial implementation. As a single case, it illustrates the pattern but does not establish its frequency.
blocks.zh: 在这个例子中,尽管部分执行中的证据相互冲突,但生成的延续仍沿用了重新命名的识别器所建议的功能。 作为单一案例,它说明了模式,但没有确定其频率。

blocks.en: Together, the selection results, summarization comparisons, and completion case provide converging evidence that misleading identifiers can directionally influence outputs in the evaluated tasks. The evidence goes beyond an undirected performance drop, while remaining observational with respect to the model’s internal mechanism.
blocks.zh: 选择结果、汇总比较和完成案例共同提供了一致的证据,表明误导性识别器可定向地影响所评价任务的产出。 证据超越了未定向的性能下降,而对该模型的内部机制仍然持观察态度。

blocks.en: 5.2. Impact of Identifier Type
blocks.zh: 5.2. 标识器类型的影响

blocks.en: After examining the directional influence of misleading names, we further compare the effects of modifying different identifier types. Because lexical properties are difficult to quantify directly, this analysis uses within-sample replacements grouped by identifier role.
blocks.zh: 在研究了误导名称的方向影响后,我们进一步比较了修改不同标识类型的效果. 由于词典性质难以直接量化,本分析使用以标识作用分类的样本内置替换.

blocks.en: Function names, parameters, and local variables occupy different syntactic roles and may differ in typical descriptive content. Function names often summarize overall behavior, parameters describe inputs, and local variables describe intermediate values. These are tendencies rather than fixed naming rules.
blocks.zh: 函数名称,参数,和本地变量具有不同的合成作用,在典型描述性内容上可能有所不同. 函数名称经常总结整体行为,参数描述输入,本地变量描述中间值. 这些都是倾向,而不是固定的命名规则.

blocks.en: For the experiment, we randomly select one identifier in the original code snippet for modification and classify it into one of these three groups. We then statistically analyze the performance changes for each group.
blocks.zh: 对于实验,我们在原代码片段中随机选择一个标识符进行修改,并将其分类为这三组中的一组. 然后我们从统计角度分析每个组的性能变化。

blocks.en: Table 10 reports the single-identifier results. Replacing a function name yields the lowest average ROUGE-L score, followed by parameters and local variables. Function names also have the lowest mean occurrence count (1.11), so raw frequency alone does not explain the ordering. The aggregate comparison does not, however, rule out other differences among identifier types.
blocks.zh: 表10报告了单一识别结果。 替换一个函数名产生最低平均ROUGE-L分数,其次是参数和本地变量. 函数名称也有最小的偶数(1.11),因此仅原始频率并不能解释订单. 然而,汇总比较并不排除标识类型之间的其他差异。

blocks.en: Identifier types also differ in syntactic position, scope, and typical descriptive content, and these factors are not separated by this experiment. We therefore interpret the table as an association between identifier role and sensitivity, not as a causal estimate of identifier type alone.
blocks.zh: 识别器类型在综合位置,范围,和典型的描述性内容上也有所不同,这些因素并没有被这一实验所分离. 因此,我们将表格解释为标识作用和敏感性之间的联系,而不是仅仅作为标识类型的一个因果关系估计。

blocks.en: 5.3. Section Summary
blocks.zh: 5.3. 节摘要

blocks.en: RQ2 contributes two observations. First, donor comparisons show directional influence from misleading names in the evaluated tasks. Second, single-identifier replacement yields different average sensitivities across identifier roles, with the largest decrease for function names. Together with RQ1, these findings support the lexical-overemphasis interpretation within the tested settings, without implying that all models or tasks exhibit the same degree of reliance.
blocks.zh: RQ2提供了两项意见。 首先,捐助方的比较表明,在所评价的任务中,误导性名称具有方向影响。 第二,单一识别器替换在识别器角色中产生不同的平均敏感性,函数名称减少最多。 与RQ1一起,这些结论支持在所测试的环境下对词典-过分强调的解释,但并不意味着所有模型或任务都表现出同样程度的依赖.

blocks.en: 6. RQ3: Probing the Mitigability of Lexical Overemphasis
blocks.zh: 6个 RQ3: 检验表征过度强调的可减轻性

blocks.en: The preceding results identify settings in which misleading or uninformative names reduce reliability. RQ3 probes the persistence of this behavior through two intervention families: (1) transformed examples or instructions at inference time and (2) fine-tuning data with reduced lexical information. These interventions test whether awareness at inference time or adaptation during training readily reduces the gap between original and lexically modified code.
blocks.zh: 上述结果确定了误导性或非信息化名称降低可靠性的设置。 RQ3通过两个干预家族来探究这种行为的持久性:(1)在推论时间转换实例或指示;(2)用减少的词汇信息微调数据. 这些干预措施检验了推断时的认识或培训期间的适应是否容易缩小原规则和经修改的法规之间的差距。

blocks.en: 6.1. Prompt-Based Diagnostic Interventions
blocks.zh: 6.1. 快速诊断干预

blocks.en: Leveraging the instruction-following capability of larger models, we use in-context learning to test whether explicitly alerting a model to lexical changes reduces its sensitivity ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Dong et al., 2024 ) . Specifically, we enhance prompts with transformed examples and transformation guidelines. If lack of awareness is the main source of the observed behavior, these interventions should reduce the gap between original and confusing naming conditions.
blocks.zh: 利用较大模型的指令跟随能力,我们利用内文学习来测试明确提醒模型对词典变化的注意是否降低了它的灵敏度(张等,2023;董等,2024). 具体地说,我们用改变的范例和改变的指南来增强提示。 如果缺乏意识是被观察到行为的主要来源,这些干预应缩小原始命名条件与混淆命名条件之间的差距.

blocks.en: We now elaborate on the prompt designs we employed and their underlying rationale.
blocks.zh: 我们现在阐述我们采用的迅速设计及其根本理由。

blocks.en: • In-context learning via perturbed examples Based on the few-shot learning setting in the previous task, we incorporate typical perturbed examples with the correct answer into the prompt. This intervention tests whether demonstrations of lexical variation help the LLM discount unreliable names. • In-context learning via transformation Inspired by Chain-of-Thought prompting ( Wei et al., 2022 ) , we incorporate an intermediate reasoning step. Specifically, we inform the model that variable names may have been altered and instruct it to sanitize the input code via anonymous renaming before generating a response, with an example demonstrating the process. This tests whether an explicit sanitization step can mitigate the misleading effect.
blocks.zh: • 通过令人不安的实例进行文字学习 基于前一个任务中的几发学习设定,我们把典型的扰动例子和正确的答案融入了即时. 这种干预检验了LLM折扣不可靠名称的Lexical变异表现是否有帮助. • 在 " 思想链 " 的激励下(Wei等人,2022年),通过转变进行文字学习,我们纳入了中间推理步骤。 具体地说,我们告诉模型,可变名称可能已经改变,并指示它通过匿名重命名来对输入代码进行消毒,然后生成一个响应,并举例说明这一过程。 这考验了明确的消毒步骤是否能够减轻误导效应.

blocks.en: In-context learning via perturbed examples
blocks.zh: 通过令人不安的实例进行文字学习

blocks.en: Based on the few-shot learning setting in the previous task, we incorporate typical perturbed examples with the correct answer into the prompt. This intervention tests whether demonstrations of lexical variation help the LLM discount unreliable names.
blocks.zh: 基于前一个任务中的几发学习设定,我们把典型的扰动例子和正确的答案融入了即时. 这种干预检验了LLM折扣不可靠名称的Lexical变异表现是否有帮助.

blocks.en: In-context learning via transformation
blocks.zh: 通过转换进行内容内学习

blocks.en: Inspired by Chain-of-Thought prompting ( Wei et al., 2022 ) , we incorporate an intermediate reasoning step. Specifically, we inform the model that variable names may have been altered and instruct it to sanitize the input code via anonymous renaming before generating a response, with an example demonstrating the process. This tests whether an explicit sanitization step can mitigate the misleading effect.
blocks.zh: 被思想链所启发 (Wei et al., 2022),我们纳入了一个中间推理步骤. 具体地说,我们告诉模型,可变名称可能已经改变,并指示它通过匿名重命名来对输入代码进行消毒,然后生成一个响应,并举例说明这一过程。 这考验了明确的消毒步骤是否能够减轻误导效应.

The evaluation settings (original vs. confusing) are indicated by colors. In the legend, "Both" refers to using both interventions simultaneously. Under several interventions, performance in the Confusing condition improves, but a gap relative to the Original condition remains.
blocks.zh: 图 8. 快速诊断干预下的业绩。 每个模型的结果分为左边的"不干预"和右边的"Intervention". 评价设置(原文与混淆)用颜色表示. 在传说中,"两个"是指同时使用两种干预. 在一些干预措施下,混淆状态的表现有所改善,但与原始状态相比仍存在差距。

blocks.en: Figure 8 reports the prompt interventions under Original and Confusing naming. Original-condition scores change little in these results, whereas several Confusing-condition scores improve. For GPT-3.5-turbo and DeepSeek-Coder-V2, the best observed intervention approaches the Perturbative score in Table 4 but remains below the Anonymous and Original scores.

blocks.en: These results suggest that explicit examples and transformation instructions can reduce part of the measured gap. None of the tested prompt-based interventions eliminates the gap between Original and Confusing naming.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,明确的例子和转化指示可以缩小部分测量到的差距。 任何经过测试的即时干预都不能消除原名和混淆命名之间的差距。

blocks.en: 6.2. Fine-Tuning-Based Diagnostic Interventions
blocks.zh: 6.2. 基于罚款的诊断 干预措施

blocks.en: For the smaller open-source models, we use fine-tuning rather than instruction prompting as the second diagnostic intervention. We compare the original training set with a fully anonymized version and a mixed set containing equal proportions of original and anonymized examples. We do not train directly on Confusing examples because donor selection does not define a stable target distribution. Models fine-tuned on the original data serve as the reference.
blocks.zh: 对于较小的开源模型,我们使用微调而不是指示作为第二次诊断干预。 我们把原始训练集与完全无名化的版本和包含相同比例的原始和无名化实例的混合训练集进行比较。 我们不直接训练“混淆”的例子,因为捐助者的选择没有确定一个稳定的目标分布。 对原始数据进行微调的模型可作为参考。

blocks.en: Table 11. Effect of fine-tuning-based diagnostic interventions on code summarization
blocks.zh: 表11. 基于微调的诊断干预对代码汇总的影响

blocks.en: Table 11 shows that training on anonymized data yields the largest observed gains under Confusing naming for all three models, accompanied by lower Original-condition scores. Mixed-data training retains more of the Original performance and improves Anonymous performance, but produces smaller gains under Confusing naming.
blocks.zh: 表11显示,匿名数据培训在对所有三种模型进行命名的同时,加上较低的原始条件分数,取得了最大的观测收益。 混合数据培训保留了更多的原始性能并改进匿名性能,但在混淆命名下产生较小的收益.

blocks.en: Although these interventions improve some Anonymous and Confusing scores, a gap relative to Original remains for the tested models and fine-tuning settings.
blocks.zh: 虽然这些干预措施改善了一些匿名和混淆的分数,但与原始数据相比,测试模型和微调设置仍有差距。

blocks.en: 6.3. Section Summary
blocks.zh: 6.3. 节摘要

blocks.en: We used representative mitigation strategies as diagnostic interventions. Some improve performance under lexically modified conditions, but none eliminates the measured gap. Together with RQ2, this establishes the persistence of lexical overemphasis across the evaluated prompt- and fine-tuning-based interventions. The broader scope of this conclusion is addressed in Threats to Validity.
blocks.zh: 我们使用有代表性的缓解战略作为诊断性干预措施。 有的在经语法修改的条件下提高了性能,但无一能消除测量到的差距. 这与 " RQ2 " 一样,确定在经过评价的迅速和微调的干预措施中,语法过分强调的现象持续存在。 这一结论的更广泛范围在 " 效力威胁 " 中述及。

blocks.en: As a secondary observation, anonymization avoids actively misleading names but also removes potentially useful information. Prior work reports comparable performance on anonymized code in some scenarios ( Yan and Li, 2021 ) . Determining when anonymization is beneficial requires a separate robustness evaluation and is not established by RQ3.
blocks.zh: 作为次要的观察,无名化避免了主动误导名字,但也消除了潜在的有用信息. 先前的工作报告了一些情景中匿名代码的可比较性能(Yan和Li, 2021 ) . 确定匿名何时有益需要单独进行强性评价,而不由RQ3确定。

blocks.en: 7. Discussion
blocks.zh: 7个 讨论情况

blocks.en: Across the evaluated models and primary tasks, the three RQs establish lexical overemphasis as a pervasive pattern that persists under the tested interventions. The type-inference control qualifies its magnitude: when the answer is locally determined without the target name, naming effects are smaller and directionally inconsistent. The larger effects in the original tasks partly reflect settings in which lexical information can be useful, while RQ2 shows that misleading names can nevertheless guide outputs. We next discuss possible contributions from input processing and training tendencies, treating them as hypotheses rather than causes established by output behavior.
blocks.zh: 在所评价的模型和主要任务中,三个 " 标准 " 将 " 过分强调 " 确定为在所试验的干预措施下持续存在的普遍模式。 类型推导控制可以限定其大小:当答案是局部确定的,没有目标名称,命名效果较小,方向不一致. 原始任务中的较大影响部分反映了词汇信息可以有用的环境,而RQ2则表明误导性名称仍然可以指导输出. 我们接下来讨论来自投入处理和培训倾向的可能贡献,把它们当作假设而不是产出行为所证实的原因。

blocks.en: 7.1. Data Processing of LLMs
blocks.zh: 7.1. 法学硕士学位的数据处理

blocks.en: Face/Off changes the identifier tokens presented to a model and therefore changes its input representation, while eligible renamings preserve program behavior. This representational change need not alter a task-relevant conclusion when the unchanged implementation determines the answer. Figure 9 depicts the possible pathway schematically rather than identifying a causal mechanism.
blocks.zh: Face/Off 更改向模型呈现的标识符,从而改变其输入表示,而符合条件的重命名则保留程序行为. 当执行不变决定了答案时,这种代表性变化不必改变与任务有关的结论。 图9描绘了可能的路径,而不是确定一种因果机制。

blocks.en: Figure 9. A schematic illustration of how lexical perturbation changes an LLM’s input representation and may affect its output. A schematic illustration of how lexical perturbation changes an LLM's input representation and may affect its output.
blocks.zh: 图9. 词汇扰动如何改变LLM的输入表示并可能影响其产出的示意图。 示意图说明LLM的输入表达方式如何变化,并可能影响其输出.

blocks.en: The experiments show that task-relevant conclusions are not always stable under these changes. Semantically rich identifiers may receive substantial weight during processing ( Yang et al., 2024c ) , so removing or contradicting them can affect the output even when the relevant program evidence is unchanged. We interpret this as a reliability tension , not as a rejection of software naturalness or proof of an architectural mismatch: identifier meanings are useful predictive signals, but they are not guaranteed to be correct.
blocks.zh: 实验表明,在这些变化中,与任务有关的结论并不总是稳定的。 语义丰富的识别符在处理过程中可能获得相当的权重(Yang等人,2024c),因此,即使相关程序证据没有改变,移除或相矛盾也会影响输出. 我们将此解释为可靠性的张力,而不是拒绝软件自然性或证明建筑错配:标识意义是有用的预测信号,但并不能保证它们是正确的.

blocks.en: 7.2. Training Tendencies of LLMs
blocks.zh: 7.2. 法学硕士课程的培训

blocks.en: One possible explanation is that identifier associations remain highly predictive during training and are therefore weighted strongly at inference time. Our experiments do not determine where in the model this influence arises. To probe how much summarization performance depends on exact structural relations rather than the available token set, we conduct an exploratory shuffling experiment with GPT-3.5-turbo.
blocks.zh: 一种可能的解释是,身份识别协会在培训期间仍然具有高度的预测性,因此在推论时间就具有很强的加权能力。 我们的实验不能确定这种影响在模型中在哪里产生。 为了探究总和的性能取决于确切的结构关系而不是可用的代号集,我们用GPT-3.5-涡轮进行了探索性洗涤实验.

blocks.en: We shuffle identifiers or all tokens while retaining the token multiset. Unlike the standard Face/Off conditions, these transformations are not semantics-preserving: identifier shuffling can violate binding and syntax, and all-token shuffling destroys syntactic structure.
blocks.zh: 我们先洗掉标识器或者所有符号 同时保留符号多集 与标准Face/Off条件不同的是,这些变换不是语义-保留:标识符洗涤可以违反绑定和语法,全托式洗涤会破坏合成结构.

blocks.en: Table 12. The ROUGE-L F1 results of code summarization on shuffled code snippets using GPT-3.5-turbo, together with reference values. Note that Face/Off shuffle is the only semantics-preserving method among the three.
blocks.zh: 表12. ROUGE-L F1对使用GPT-3.5-涡轮的洗牌码片段的代码汇总结果,以及参考值. 注意Face/Off Shuffle是三个中唯一的语义保留方法.

blocks.en: Table 12 shows modest ROUGE-L decreases at 25% and 50% shuffling and larger decreases at 100%. Even at full shuffling, the scores remain close to the Anonymous reference. This is compatible with lexical statistics supporting coarse one-sentence summaries after syntax is disrupted, but it does not show that the model internally behaves as a bag-of-words system.
blocks.zh: 表12显示,ROUGE-L略有下降,为25%和50%,较大下降,为100%。 即使在满分时 得分仍然接近匿名者 这与语法中断后支持粗糙的一刑摘要的词汇统计是相容的,但并不表明模型在内部表现为袋字系统.

blocks.en: This exploratory result is task-specific. Code summarization may reward topic-level lexical overlap without requiring fine-grained functional accuracy, the single-sentence prompt may amplify this effect, and identifier shuffling also disrupts syntax and binding. We did not observe a comparable pattern in our attempts on other tasks. Within these limits, full shuffling shows that lexical overlap can sustain part of the summarization score after token order is destroyed, but it neither quantifies structural reasoning nor establishes a general model mechanism.
blocks.zh: 这一探索性结果是针对具体任务的。 代码汇总可能奖励主题层面的词汇重叠,而不需要精细的功能精确度,单句句提示可能扩大这种效果,识别符洗涤也会扰乱语法和约束. 我们在其他任务的尝试中并没有看到类似的模式。 在这些限度内,完全的乱排表明,词典重叠在象征顺序被破坏后可以维持部分的归纳分数,但既不能量化结构推理,也不能建立一般模型机制.

blocks.en: 7.3. Section Summary
blocks.zh: 7.3. 节摘要

blocks.en: The behavioral results identify a reliability tension between informative identifier cues and program invariance under eligible renamings. Strong lexical associations learned during training are one plausible contributor, and the shuffling result is compatible with coarse lexical statistics supporting summarization. Neither observation directly identifies an internal mechanism.
blocks.zh: 行为结果确定了信息识别提示与符合资格的重命名下的程序变化之间的可靠性矛盾. 在培训期间所学得的强烈的词汇学协会是一个可信的贡献者,其变化结果与支持归纳的粗糙词汇学统计是一致的。 两项观察都没有直接确定内部机制。

blocks.en: 8. Threats to Validity
blocks.zh: 8. 国家 对有效性的威胁

blocks.en: 8.1. Internal Validity
blocks.zh: 8.1. 内部有效性

blocks.en: For the standard Face/Off conditions, we consistently rename eligible local bindings while retaining the program structure and operational behavior, which is designed to isolate identifier information. Residual threats include transformation errors and task-specific interactions between code and text; we address these through implementation checks and the documentation procedure in Section 3.3 . In the type-inference control, parse, compile, binding-occurrence, and alpha-equivalence checks reduce transformation risk, and paired tests are clustered by project because multiple targets can come from the same project. However, target eligibility was established through conservative automatic analysis rather than an independent human identifier-independence review. We therefore present this experiment as a supplementary semantic control rather than a confirmatory estimate for a broader type-inference population. The extended external-identifier experiment is less controlled because it inserts a binding block. Its dead-code condition estimates part of the insertion effect but does not isolate decontextualization perfectly. Table 6 shows the same condition ordering across the tested prompts, but other prompts could yield different magnitudes or patterns. Finally, benchmark contamination ( Magar and Schwartz, 2022 ; Golchin and Surdeanu, 2024 ) could affect both baseline performance and measured sensitivity, so the results should not be interpreted as contamination-free estimates.
blocks.zh: 对于标准Face/Off条件,我们一贯重命名合格的本地绑定物,同时保留程序结构和操作行为,它旨在隔离标识信息. 残余威胁包括转换错误和具体任务在代码和文本之间的相互作用;我们在第3.3节中通过执行检查和文件程序解决这些问题。 在类型推论控制中,剖析,编译,绑定-发生,以及α等效性检查降低变换风险,对子测试被项目分组,因为多个目标可以来自同一个项目. 然而,目标资格是通过保守的自动分析确定的,而不是通过独立的人的身份识别-独立审查确定的。 因此,我们提出这一试验是补充语义控制,而不是对更广泛的类型推论群的确认性估计。 扩展的外部识别器实验由于插入绑定块,因此控制较少. 它的死密码条件估计了插入效果的一部分,但并不完美地隔离解密. 表6显示,在测试的提示中,情况相同,但其他提示可能产生不同的程度或模式。 最后,基准污染(Magar和Schwartz,2022年;Golchin和Surdeanu,2024年)可能影响基线性能和测量的敏感性,因此不应将结果解释为无污染估计。

blocks.en: 8.2. Construct Validity
blocks.zh: 8.2. 建构有效性

blocks.en: The naming conditions and identifier roles operationalize lexical-information quality, but we lack a direct quantitative measure that captures every aspect of informativeness, naturalness, or ambiguity. The observed patterns are therefore conditional on the evaluated tasks, models, programs, and transformations.
blocks.zh: 命名条件和标识作用可以使词汇信息质量发挥作用,但我们缺乏直接的量化尺度,无法捕捉信息、自然或模糊的方方面面。 因此,所观察到的模式取决于评估的任务、模式、方案和转变。

blocks.en: A potential concern is that tasks such as code summarization couple identifier words with ground-truth text through lexical-overlap metrics. For the CodeSearchNet-based tasks, explicit references to the subject function follow the corresponding code condition, while parameter words in natural-language prose are retained to preserve the description’s semantic content (Section 3.3 ). Exact subject-function names occur in only 2 of the 600 CodeSearchNet descriptions used in this evaluation. Consequently, condition-specific synchronization changes the accompanying text for only these cases; parameter names and randomly selected negative descriptions remain unchanged. This low incidence limits the extent to which the aggregate performance patterns can be attributed to reference-text rewriting. The targeted procedure does not make every identifier-like word lexically aligned. HumanEval does not present its natural-language description to the model. The directional analyses in Section 5.1 provide complementary evidence: donor-reference similarities exceed random-pair comparisons, which is less consistent with arbitrary label disruption than with influence from donor identifiers. These analyses reduce, but do not eliminate, the construct-validity concern because the tasks and metrics still differ in their lexical requirements.
blocks.zh: 潜在的关切是,诸如代码汇总等任务,通过语法重叠度量法,将标识词与地面真实文本合并。 对于基于CodeSearchNet的任务,对主题函数的明确引用遵循了相应的代码条件,而自然语义中的参数词被保留,以保留描述的语义内容(第3.3节). 准确的主题功能名称只出现在本次评价使用的600个代码SearchNet描述中的2个. 因此,针对具体条件的同步只改变这些案例的随附文本;参数名称和随机选择的负面描述保持不变. 这种低发生率限制了总体性能模式可归因于参考文本重写的程度. 定向程序并没有使每一个类似于识别特征的词在逻辑上一致。 HumanEval没有向模型展示其自然语言描述. 第5.1节中的方向分析提供了补充证据:捐助方参考的相似性超过随机-pair比较,这与任意标签中断不一致,而与捐助方识别特征的影响不一致。 由于任务和衡量标准在词汇要求上仍有差异,这些分析减少但并不消除对建构有效性的关切。

blocks.en: Finally, the mechanism-level discussion is based on output behavior and exploratory perturbations rather than direct access to internal causal processes. The proposed explanations should therefore be treated as hypotheses for future mechanistic and experimental work.
blocks.zh: 最后,机制层面的讨论是基于产出行为和探索性扰动,而不是直接接触内部因果过程. 因此,拟议的解释应作为未来机械和实验工作的假设。

blocks.en: 8.3. External Validity
blocks.zh: 8.3. 外部有效性

blocks.en: We evaluated models with different architectures, sizes, and access types across four code-comprehension tasks. Repeated patterns across these settings provide within-study replication, but they do not guarantee generalization to other models, languages, tasks, or repositories. In particular, the HumanEval code-completion problems are relatively small, and the controlled snippets do not capture dependencies and workflows found in large codebases. The type-inference control deliberately selects cases with locally sufficient evidence, uses a closed set of 15 labels, and is dominated by primitive types; this conservative construction improves isolation but makes the task easier and limits generalization to user-defined, repository-dependent, or unrestricted types. Its model set also differs from the original four-task evaluation, so we do not use it for direct numerical comparison. Future work should test the same hypotheses in repository-level, documentation-rich, tool-augmented, and more difficult type-inference settings.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了不同架构、大小和接入类型的模型,涉及四个编码综合任务。 在这些设置中反复出现的模式提供了研究内复制,但并不能保证对其他模型,语言,任务或寄存器的概括. 特别是HumanEval代码补全问题相对较小,被控制的片段无法捕捉到在大型代码库中发现的依赖性和工作流程. 类型推导控制有意选择具有本地充足证据的病例,使用15个标签的闭合套件,并以原始类型为主;这种保守的构造改善了隔离性,但使任务更加容易,并且将概括性限制在用户定义的,寄存器依赖的,或不受限制的类型. 它的模型集也不同于最初的四任务评价,因此我们不使用它进行直接的数字比较. 今后的工作应当在存储层、文献丰富、工具强化和更加困难的类型推论设置中测试同样的假设。

blocks.en: 8.4. Ecological Validity
blocks.zh: 8.4. 生态有效性

blocks.en: Confusing names and systematic placeholders are controlled stress-test conditions, not estimates of how frequently the same patterns occur in everyday development. Anonymous naming resembles some information-depleted artifacts, such as minified, obfuscated, decompiled, or poorly named code, but it is not a general proxy for all low-quality code. Consequently, our results establish sensitivity under the tested interventions; they do not estimate the population-level failure rate in real projects.
blocks.zh: 混淆姓名和系统的占位者是受控制的压力测试条件,而不是对日常发展中发生同样情况频率的估计。 匿名命名类似于一些信息耗尽的文物,如精密化,模糊化,分解化,或命名不良的代码,但它并不是所有低质量代码的一般代名词. 因此,我们的成果在经过测试的干预措施下确定了敏感性;它们没有估计实际项目中人口一级的失败率。

blocks.en: Human program comprehension is also multi-source and task-dependent. Descriptive identifiers and recognizable beacons can help programmers, while misleading beacons can also produce false initial interpretations ( Schankin et al., 2018 ; Wiedenbeck, 1991 ) . Evidence that experts form representations from procedural relations ( Pennington, 1987 ) does not imply that humans reason independently of names. Moreover, professional developers use browsers, documentation, and tools during comprehension ( Xia et al., 2018 ) . Our experiment intentionally restricts the context supplied to the model and, where a task pairs code with documentation, controls that textual channel together with the naming condition. This restriction improves internal validity by isolating identifier information, but reduces ecological realism. It is a property of the experimental design, not evidence that an LLM cannot use documentation or tool feedback. We therefore compare behavior only under the supplied context and do not claim a categorical difference between human and model comprehension.
blocks.zh: 人类程序理解也具有多来源和任务依赖性. 描述性标识符和可识别信标可以帮助程序员,而误导信标也可以产生虚假的初始解释(Schankin等人,2018年;Wiedenbeck,1991年.). 专家通过程序关系形成陈述的证据(Pennington, 1987)并不意味着人类的理性独立于姓名. 此外,专业开发人员在理解过程中使用浏览器,文档和工具(Xia等人,2018年). 我们的实验有意限制提供给模型的上下文,如果任务代码与文档对齐,则会控制文本通道与命名条件。 这种限制通过隔离标识信息来提高内部有效性,但降低了生态现实性. 它是实验设计的一个属性,而不是证明LLM不能使用文档或工具反馈的证据. 因此,我们仅根据所提供的背景来比较行为,并不声称人类理解与模型理解之间有绝对的区别.

blocks.en: 9. Conclusion and Implications
blocks.zh: 9. 结论和影响

blocks.en: This empirical study investigates lexical overemphasis in LLM code comprehension, characterizes its behavior under controlled identifier transformations, and uses diagnostic mitigation attempts to evaluate its persistence. Within the Face/Off framework, lexical overemphasis is pervasive across the evaluated models and original four tasks, and persists under the representative prompt- and fine-tuning-based interventions we test. A targeted type-inference control confirms a boundary on this pattern: in its conservatively screened subset, naming effects are smaller and directionally inconsistent when local program evidence suffices to determine the answer. Together, the results identify a task-dependent reliability tension between useful distributional naming cues and task-relevant structural evidence; they neither reject software naturalness nor imply that identifiers should be ignored.
blocks.zh: 这项经验性研究调查了LLM编码理解中的词典过度强调,在受控识别器转换下描述其行为特征,并利用诊断缓解尝试来评价其持久性. 在 " 面/面 " 框架内,语法过度强调贯穿于所评价的模式和最初的四项任务,并在我们试验的具有代表性的迅速和微调干预下持续存在。 一个目标类型的推论控制证实了这个模式上的边界:在其保守筛选的子集中,当本地程序证据足以确定答案时,命名效果较小,方向不一致. 结果共同查明了有用的分布式命名提示和与任务相关的结构证据之间的依赖任务可靠性的紧张关系;它们既不拒绝软件自然性,也不意味着应忽略标识符。

blocks.en: For practitioners, the results motivate caution when identifier quality is uncertain and independent validation when correctness is consequential; they do not establish anonymization as a universally beneficial safeguard. For researchers, they motivate training and evaluation methods that retain the predictive benefits of natural code while checking whether conclusions remain stable under semantics-preserving changes and grounded in program structure.
blocks.zh: 对从业人员而言,当识别质量不确定时,结果促使他们谨慎行事,而当正确性随之而来时,则需要独立验证;结果并不将匿名确定为普遍有益的保障。 对于研究人员来说,它们激励培训和评价方法保留自然代码的预测效益,同时检查结论在语义保留变化下是否保持稳定,并基于程序结构.
